ranking: Biggest squeeze first: lanes out ÷ lanes in, smallest first; ties go to the drop losing more lanes.
assumptions: Counts lanes only. It does not know how many cars use each road, so a small drop with heavy traffic can jam worse than a big one.
Only highways and their ramps ([motorway motorway_link trunk trunk_link]) on or next to [E5 E11].
Junctions with traffic signals are skipped: movements take turns there, so more lanes in than out is normal.
Drops within 400 m of a toll booth are skipped: plazas widen briefly and narrow back.
Lane counts come from OpenStreetMap; untagged roads use a class default and are flagged lanes_inferred.
